signed_reason: I ran and reviewed the CMB lacunarity evaluation: 42/42 cases pass, including negative controls that complete state sets are NOT flagged as lacunar. A first run FAILED 39/42 and was not signed. All three failures were real code defects in api/pipeline/lacunarity.py and were fixed, not waived: the gap map emitted Scheme-B operator names ('Critical Evaluation' for ^3, 'Causal Reasoning' for ^8) instead of the canonical Noetics, which is the exact drift the project's own anti-drift rule names; a short domain list was silently reported as no-gaps, a false negative in the one function whose job is reporting absence; and a short drive list crashed with IndexError. SCOPE: absence detection and naming. NOT a claim about lacunarity in any deployed system.
